The [[Khormai/Legends|Khormai]] [[Species/Legends|species]] used a special kind of '''horn''' to call [[aelid]]s, or ice worms, from below their [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] surface. The Khormai then were able to command the aelids to transport them about the world within their gullets.
